.comment: Project-shared agent configuration. This file travels with the repo, so it carries only what is every cloner's business: the hooks that enforce the house rules. All three are guarded by Test-Path and resolve against the project directory, so they are inert outside a full checkout.

Permissions deliberately do NOT live here. A permission allowlist is a personal policy, and shipping one in a public repo pre-approves commands for whoever clones it -- including, before 2026-08-11, az read commands that would have let an agent dump a cloner's own Azure app settings unprompted. Machine-local policy belongs in settings.local.json, which is gitignored.
